name: proto-blocks/oit-text-services-cards
title: OIT Text + Services Cards
description: Industry-page intro section: heading + body + red subhead followed by a row of clickable service cards and an optional 'View All' CTA. Scroll-triggered reveal, gradient or white background.

showGradient.label: Light-grey gradient background
showGradient.help: On = light-grey → white vertical gradient. Off = solid white.

highlightWord.label: Highlight word/phrase in heading
highlightWord.help: First case-insensitive occurrence in the heading is wrapped in a red span.

showViewAll.label: Show "View All" card
showViewAll.help: Appends the black CTA card after the last service card.

viewAllUrl.label: View All URL
viewAllUrl.help: Destination for the View All card. Defaults to # if empty.

viewAllLabel.label: View All label
viewAllLabel.help: Two-line label inside the black card. Use a line break inside the editor (Shift+Enter) is not supported; the template auto-splits on the first space.
